content:
ana (partnerships): Quick pulse - partners asking for a pre-announce window for H200 + MI300. Can we shift embargo by ~2 weeks to avoid supply mismatch? Any red flags?
kevin (platform): sounds fine in principle. Big risk is Dedicated bookings already planned for next quarter. If we move, sales and marketplace owners need notice. @nora @sophia
marta (hw-ops): H200 shipments still constrained. MI300 incoming but firmware validation on early silicon is slower than expected. 2-week buffer helps finish certs.
sanjay (eng): We can add a routing fallback to B200 and quantized MI300 variants for critical paths. Expect ~15-25% perf drop on heavy LTR workloads, but latency SLOs should hold with autoscale tweaks.
sophia (product): For marketplace we'll need SKU tags + an "availability window" flag. Legal okay with a soft pre-announce as long as we avoid firm GA dates? @kevin
marta (hw-ops): Legal prefers "limited availability" language. No promised GA.
nora (sales): customer note: 3 pilots asked for H200 access week-of-April. If embargo shifts, we need early-access offers or credits to keep deals alive.
deploy-bot: inventory-scan: H200 stock=low, MI300 incoming=2 shipments (ETA 14 days), Gaudi stock=medium
kevin (platform): Ops TODOs: (1) implement temporary routing fallback (2) add marketplace metadata field (3) draft ops FAQ for SI partners. I can own 1+3.
marta (hw-ops): I'll validate firmware timeline and confirm go/no-go by EOD Thursday.
sophia (product): I'll draft marketplace blurb and short Q&A, then loop in legal.
nora (sales): Please also provide a 1-line customer-facing matrix for each config. Example: "H200: limited by supply; MI300: staggered availability; B200: generally available"
kevin (platform): Good example. We'll use that as temporary copy.
sanjay (eng): I'll prepare the routing policy patch: `route-policy: prefer-h200 -> fallback-mi300-quant -> fallback-b200` and a small canary.
nana (partnerships): typo -> ana (partnerships) updated partners. I'll send partner PM note after the 11am PST sync.
kevin (platform): Propose 11:00am PST sync tomorrow to confirm messaging and handoffs.
marta (hw-ops): +1 for 11am PST.
nora (sales): I'll invite the key accounts and channel their questions.
sophia (product): Will bring draft marketplace text to the sync.
sanjay (eng): will bring test results for quantized MI300 variants.
nana (partnerships): thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for partner-facing timing and embargo.
